shots.js: await __gt.player.show(5, false); document.querySelector('.overlay').hidden = true; document.querySelectorAll('.cue.off').forEach(e => e.classList.remove('off')); __gt.player.fit(); const sl=document.querySelector('.slide'), b=sl.querySelector('.s-body'); return {fit: sl.style.getPropertyValue('--fit'), bodySH: b.scrollHeight, bodyCH: b.clientHeight, slSH: sl.scrollHeight, slCH: sl.clientHeight, flowSW: b.firstElementChild.scrollWidth, flowCW: b.firstElementChild.clientWidth, used: (sl.lastElementChild.getBoundingClientRect().bottom - sl.firstElementChild.getBoundingClientRect().top)/sl.clientHeight};
